vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sg-helper-match
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is designed to search a domestic helper database via a public API (sunriselink.sg) and includes detailed instructions for privacy-conscious agent behavior. However, it is classified as suspicious due to a shell injection vulnerability in the SKILL.md file, where the 'search_helpers' tool executes a command using '${input}' wrapped in single quotes. This construction allows for potential arbitrary command execution if the input is not strictly sanitized by the runtime. The underlying script logic in 'scripts/search_helpers.mjs' is otherwise benign and uses an allowlist for query parameters.

llm.summary: The skill's code and runtime instructions align with its stated purpose (searching Sunrise Link's public helper database), request no credentials, and have no unusual install behavior.

dimensions.detail: The name, description, SKILL.md, README, CLAUDE.md, and the script all consistently implement a search against Sunrise Link's public API. No unrelated permissions, binaries, or secrets are requested. Minor note: registry metadata lists 'Source: unknown' and 'Homepage: none' while the SKILL.md/README claim Sunrise Link as the author and point to https://www.sunriselink.sg — you should verify the skill origin if provenance matters.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md restricts the agent to gathering filter criteria from the user, running the local search script with those filters, and formatting results. It explicitly forbids returning PII and directs users to the official site for contact details. Instructions do not ask the agent to read system files, environment variables, or contact any endpoints other than the Sunrise Link API and site.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with one small local script (no install spec, no downloads, no third-party packages). The script uses Node.js 18+ built-in fetch and performs a single GET to a clearly named API endpoint on sunriselink.sg. No archive/extract or remote code execution on install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The API it calls is public and the script does not attempt to access unrelated secrets or services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is user-invocable, not always-enabled, and does not request elevated or persistent privileges. It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements what it claims: a thin wrapper around Sunrise Link's public helper search API. Before installing, verify the skill source (registry shows 'Source: unknown' while the SKILL.md cites Sunrise Link) to ensure you're getting the official package. Run it in a controlled environment if you plan to execute the included Node script (it issues network requests to sunriselink.sg). Note the skill intentionally excludes PII; if you need candidate contact details or photos you must follow the profile links to the official site. If you have policy concerns about automated network calls, do not enable autonomous invocation for this skill and review its usage with your security team.
